legal.risk.s1.summary: Prices can fall as fast as they rise, and hacks, fraud or a firm failing could also cost you what you put in.
legal.risk.s2.summary: The UK’s compensation scheme (FSCS) doesn’t cover this investment, and the Financial Ombudsman Service can’t consider complaints about it.
legal.risk.s3.summary: Selling depends on someone wanting to buy at that moment, and outages or attacks can delay you.
legal.risk.s4.summary: It can be hard to see what you’re taking on. Do your own research, and be wary of anything that sounds too good to be true.
legal.risk.s5.summary: Spreading your money across different investments lowers the risk. A common rule of thumb: no more than 10% in high-risk investments.
